svg.title: Greenhouse grower — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as greenhouse grower, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: Two young plants grow from a raised nutrient trough beneath two separate dripper outlets. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a bob haircut, a rounded face.
